description: This Java class implements a shuffle writer for Apache Spark's sort-based shuffle, specifically the bypass merge sort path. It handles writing records to per-partition files, concatenating them into a single output, and managing checksum calculations and resource cleanup.

classes.name: BypassMergeSortShuffleWriter
classes.description: A shuffle writer for Spark's sort-based shuffle that writes data to per-partition files and concatenates them, supporting checksum calculations and resource management.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the input records to partition files, manages checksum updates, and constructs the MapStatus.

methods.name: getPartitionLengths
methods.description: Returns the lengths of each partition's data in the output file.

methods.name: getRowBasedChecksums
methods.description: Returns the array of row-based checksum objects (test only).

methods.name: getAggregatedChecksumValue
methods.description: Calculates and returns the aggregated checksum value across all row-based checksums.

methods.name: writePartitionedData
methods.description: Concatenates per-partition files into a single output file and returns partition lengths.

methods.name: writePartitionedDataWithChannel
methods.description: Copies data from a file to an output channel using NIO.

methods.name: writePartitionedDataWithStream
methods.description: Copies data from a file to a writer's output stream.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the writer, optionally returning the MapStatus if successful, or deleting output files if failed.
